name: A-R92 one-shot scalar calibration
status: specified before new generation; no R92 outcomes observed
coefficient: lambda_SC = 0.25 * I_U / I_R, separately for every source/seed, using frozen native profiles
intervention: Constant lambda_SC times original P times own-state residual; no stepwise normalization or coefficient search
fixed: Same FLUX.1-dev revision, BF16 network/FP32 integration, 512px, 28 steps, source/target prompts, reference, memory, original map construction
inference: Average seeds within each source; 20000 category-stratified source bootstraps; 1000000 two-sided source sign flips, plus-one; Holm across the two prespecified LPIPS tests; PCG64 seed 92013
historical_edit_MAE: Available for U25 and REQ_U; native REQ edit MAE is missing and is not imputed
interpretation: Different scientific outcome contrasts can demonstrate added value for this one-shot comparator.
An RMS mismatch alone is a control-accuracy result, not evidence of a changed scientific conclusion.
A CI containing zero does not establish equivalence; no equivalence margin is specified.
Magnitude and timing deviations are reported together; association does not identify their separate causal effects.
Do not retune scalar coefficients after outcomes or add runs to select a favorable result.
stopping: Generate the fixed 80 outputs, analyze all paired cases, revise the contribution according to results, then finish this submission; no automatic additional experiments
execution: Existing archived anchors and comparator scores reused; no regenerated baseline, additional seed or sentinel output
